description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ehala Ambathale, Thirappane D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110893 (24/0664)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (primarily "The State"), and land classifications. The content focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
